You watch how your opponent recovers from each movement, step where their balance will be weakest, and strike as their foot begins to land.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Name the weakness you are exploiting and make a melee or unarmed attack. You need not invent a hidden vulnerability; stance and timing are enough.

Weak
4 physical damage and push 1.
Standard
4 physical damage, push 1 and knock prone.
Strong
6 physical damage, push 2, knock prone and apply Dazed 1.
